cohort: The study cohort included birth records from mothers in Muar District, Johor, collected from January 1st to December 31st, 2012.
finding: Advanced maternal age was significantly associated with pregnancy-induced hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, and Caesarean section, but negatively associated with anaemia, with no significant association found for adverse foetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with Caesarean section (aOR: 2.21; 95%CI: 1.53-3.19).
cross-section timing: Data were collected from birth records from January 1st 2012 until December 31st 2012.
